name: investment_npv_payback
title: Economic evaluation of an energy-saving investment: net present value and simple payback time
summary: Year-by-year cash flow of an energy-saving measure over its lifetime: discounted cash flow method (net present value NPV_1 of the escalated benefit and cost, discounted at the rate k) and simple payback method (undiscounted accumulation NPV_2, payback time PBT_2). No thermodynamics: meant to be fed with the cost and saving figures of an energy model.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), economic evaluation of energy-saving measures
